description:
Get the current diagram XML (fetches latest from browser, including user's manual edits). Call this when you don't know the current diagram content (cell IDs, pages, structure) — e.g. before editing a diagram you didn't create in this conversation, or after edit_diagram was rejected because the user changed the diagram in the browser.

Returns the full <mxfile> by default. If a page selector is provided, returns just that page's <mxGraphModel> embedded in a one-page <mxfile> wrapper.

page_id.description: Target a page by its id (as returned by list_pages or add_page). Wins over page_name and page_index when multiple are set.

page_index.description: Target a page by its 0-based tab index. Used only when page_id and page_name are not set.

page_name.description: Target a page by its display name (e.g. "CNN"). Used only when page_id is not set.

name: get_diagram
title: Get diagram
